name.text: Comparison between the functions f(x) and g(x)

questiontext.text:
Compare the functions \(f(x)={@fx@}\) and \(g(x)={@gx@}\) using the graph below.

[[jsxgraph width="500px" height="500px"]] var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-2, 5, 2, -2], keepaspectratio: false, showCopyright: false, axis: true, showNavigation: false }); // Define functions function f(x) { return Math.pow(x, {#power#}); // f(x)=x^10 } function g(x) { return Math.exp(x); // g(x)=e^x } // Plot function curves //var curveF = board.create('functiongraph', [f, -2, {#power#}], { strokeColor: 'blue', strokeWidth: 2, name: '\\(f(x) = x^{10}\\)' }); //var curveG = board.create('functiongraph', [g, -5, {#power#}], { strokeColor: 'red', strokeWidth: 2, name: '\\(g(x) = e^x\\)' }); // Plot function curves var curveF = board.create('functiongraph', [f, -2, {#power#}], { strokeColor: 'blue', strokeWidth: 2, name: 'f(x) = x^{ {#power#}}', withLabel: true, label: { position: 'rt', offset: [-10, 10] } }); var curveG = board.create('functiongraph', [g, -2, {#power#}], { strokeColor: 'red', strokeWidth: 2, name: 'g(x) = e^x', withLabel: true, label: { position: 'rt', offset: [10, 10] } }); // Find intersection points var intersection1 = board.create('intersection', [curveF, curveG, 0], { name: 'Intersection 1', color: 'green', size: 4 }); var intersection2 = board.create('intersection', [curveF, curveG, 1], { name: 'Intersection 1', color: 'purple', size: 4 }); // Dotted lines for intersection 1 var xLine1 = board.create('line', [[intersection1.X(), 0], intersection1], { strokeColor: 'green', dash: 2, straightFirst: false, straightLast: false }); var yLine1 = board.create('line', [[0, intersection1.Y()], intersection1], { strokeColor: 'green', dash: 2, straightFirst: false, straightLast: false }); // Dotted lines for intersection 2 var xLine2 = board.create('line', [[intersection2.X(), 0], intersection2], { strokeColor: 'purple', dash: 2, straightFirst: false, straightLast: false }); var yLine2 = board.create('line', [[0, intersection2.Y()], intersection2], { strokeColor: 'purple', dash: 2, straightFirst: false, straightLast: false }); // Calculate coordinates of intersection points var coords1 = "\\((" + intersection1.coords.usrCoords[1].toFixed(2) + ", " + intersection1.coords.usrCoords[2].toFixed(2) + ")\\)"; var coords2 = "\\((" + intersection2.coords.usrCoords[1].toFixed(2) + ", " + intersection2.coords.usrCoords[2].toFixed(2) + ")\\)"; // Update the names of intersection points to include coordinates intersection1.setAttribute({ name: '' }); intersection2.setAttribute({ name: '' }); [[/jsxgraph]]

Based on the graph, when does the graph of \(g\) surpass the graph of \(f\)?

Hint: Give your answer in the form \((x, y)\) and correct to \(2\) decimal places.

\(\big( x, y \big)=\) \(\big(\) [[input:ans1]] \(,\) [[input:ans2]] \(\big)\) [[validation:ans1]] [[validation:ans2]]
